title: Infineon expects data center revenue to grow from €1.5B in FY2026 to €2.5B in FY2027, as it and EU peers STMicro and NXP benefit from AI infrastructure demand (Christina Kyriasoglou/Bloomberg)
summary: Christina Kyriasoglou / Bloomberg: Infineon expects data center revenue to grow from €1.5B in FY2026 to €2.5B in FY2027, as it and EU peers STMicro and NXP benefit from AI infrastructure demand — Infineon Technologies AG forecast revenue that beat analysts' expectations in the current quarter as the German chipmaker benefits …
